name: maestro-companions
description: Seventy skills that go well with skill-maestro, chosen by evidence, not by theme: every skill the Maestro's own ledger shows was read, tried, judged to fit or rated useful in real sessions on the author's machine (pack_build.py --suggest, 2026-10-26), plus the skills those scripts import: pov-core, the engine the twenty-two point-of-view lenses run on; literal-execution, which finish-everything loads; prompt-genealogy and dead-lane-check, which demand-scan and lane-resurrection load; and transcript-miner, whose redaction rule prompt-genealogy shares. Each skill folder keeps its SKILL.md and scripts; paths and the author's name are scrubbed. Some were written for one workspace's rituals (landing, decisions, scheduled tasks); their SKILL.md says so in its first lines.
